posts.title: Emma Jay Aesthetics | Working existing demand first

copy.default:
When the diary goes quiet, the fastest reaction is usually: we need more leads.

Sometimes that's correct.

But Emma Jay Aesthetics is a good example of why we don't start there automatically.

Existing clients had already shown trust, treatment interest and prior buying behaviour. The missed opportunity was in the return path.

222Emails focused on the people who should have come back, reopened the right treatment conversations and made rebooking easy.

New leads still matter.

Working the demand you've already earned before buying more attention is often the more efficient first move.
